annotations.title: Mountain weather forecast at a place

description: The weather forecast at a place in the Alps, for its elevation: weather, precipitation, fresh snow, freezing level, temperature, wind and gusts, sunshine and thunderstorm risk, in six-hour periods of local time for up to ten days. Computed from several weather models like the forecast in the topo^alpin app. Say the elevation elevationM and the period, and the weather, precipitation, fresh snow, freezing level, wind with gusts and thunderstorm risk where they matter. temperatureC is the spread of the models, from the coldest to the warmest: give it as a range. Where freezingLevelSource is estimate, the freezing level is carried from the temperature at the place: call it estimated. Where precipitationMm is above 0 and rainMm and fresh snow are 0, only a trace falls: say so, not that it stays dry. A period marked past has ended: do not give it as forecast, and say that the day totals include it.

date.description: One day, YYYY-MM-DD in local time. Without it, from today.

days.description: Days from today, if no date is given. Default 3.

elevationM.description: The elevation that matters, if not the one of the place itself.

lang.description: Language for place names. Default en.

lat.description: Latitude, WGS 84. topo^alpin covers the Alps only.

placeId.description: When query matched several places, the placeId of the one the user means, from that list. Give it together with the same query.

query.description: Name of a summit, hut, pass or town.

name: mountain_forecast

appUrl.description: Opens this place and its forecast in the topo^alpin app.

availableDates.description: Days with a forecast, from today.

dataStale.description: True: the data is older than its source is refreshed, or the source reports a fault. Say that it may be outdated. null: unknown, not fresh.

dataUpdatedAt.description: When the data behind this answer was produced (ISO 8601, UTC; a date for a fixed release). With several sources, the oldest. null: unknown.

feelsLikeMinC.description: No longer given: always null, and removed in the next version.

freezingLevelBelowPlace.description: True if freezingLevelM lies below this elevation. Without freezingLevelM: true if the models report frost at every level they give. null: unknown.

freezingLevelM.description: Elevation of 0 °C, rounded to 100 m, as the app shows it. See freezingLevelSource. null: no temperature at this place, unknown.

freezingLevelSource.description: profile: found in the temperature profiles of the models. estimate: the profiles find no line, mostly in winter when it lies below their lowest level, and it is carried from the mean temperature at the place with 0.65 °C per 100 m. An estimate does not know inversions: call it estimated.

freshSnowCm.description: Fresh snow at this elevation from 0.5 cm, below that 0. null: no data.

past.description: The period ended before now: it is no forecast any more. Do not give it as one.

precipitationMm.description: Water equivalent, rain and snow together, from 0.1 mm. null: no data for this period.

precipitationProbabilityPct.description: Mean of the models that give a probability. null: none of them does, so it is unknown.

rainMm.description: Rain from 0.5 mm, below that 0. With precipitationMm above 0 and rain and fresh snow 0, only a trace falls: say so, not that it stays dry.

sunshineHours.description: Of the six hours of the period: the median of the models, with no sun in hours in which a model itself gives precipitation.

temperatureC.description: The spread of the weather models over the period: min is the coldest any model gives, max the warmest. Give it as a range, not as the expected temperature.

level.description: low is a low risk, not none: never say there will be no thunderstorm.

maxScore.description: The highest score the data of this period could reach, at most 7. It drops to 6 from about day 6, when fewer models give the fields: compare score with it, not with 7.

thunderstorm.description: null: no data for this period, so nothing is known about it.

code.description: WMO weather code of the middle of the period: the most severe any model gives at that hour, showers and thunderstorms only where two models give them. A more severe state that lasts long enough in the period takes over, and the code is checked against the amounts. It describes one moment, not the whole period: it can stand beside sunshine or little precipitation. Describe the period from the values, and name the code as what may happen.

freshSnowCm.description: For the whole day, also over periods marked past. null if a period of the day has no data.

precipitationMm.description: For the whole day, also over periods marked past.

disclaimer.description: Pass this on with every forecast.

elevationM.description: The elevation the values apply to.

elevationSource.description: model-grid: no elevation known, the values apply to the model terrain.

missing.description: Present where there is no forecast. Pass it on.

runAt.description: When this model run started, UTC.

modelRuns.description: The run behind each model. null: the state of the weather server is unknown.

alternatives.description: Other places or areas the query may mean, each with how to ask for it: the same query with its placeId, lat and lon, or query.

label.description: Check it: a wrong place gives a wrong forecast.

partialMatch.description: No place has the name asked for; this one has a longer name that contains it. Name the place you used, and ask the user if they may mean another.

type.description: peak, saddle, alpine_hut, wilderness_hut, shelter, tour_place (where our tours start or end), town, or point where lat and lon were given.

sources.description: Name these when using the data.

title: Mountain weather forecast at a place
